children: rose 14.69% intraday after the geothermal developer said it had agreed to supply 396 megawatts of power to Alphabet's (GOOGL) Google from its Cape Station project in Utah. Alphabet was down 1.26% intraday.

The agreement gives Google an option to buy roughly 600 megawatts more, which would take total capacity under the arrangement to nearly one gigawatt by June 2030. Cape Station is an enhanced geothermal project expected online in 2028, and Fervo said it is intended to support a potential Google data center development in the state.

The two have worked together since Fervo's Project Red pilot in Nevada came online in 2023, followed by a 115 megawatt purchase agreement with Google and NV Energy in 2024 that added geothermal supply to Nevada's grid. Demand from data centers has pushed large power buyers toward round-the-clock clean generation.

title: Google's Fervo Deal Could Reach a Gigawatt by 2030
